pilot: NATURE-02 FOREST QUALITY VERTICAL SLICE — ONE biome, THREE compositions
reviewedBy: Map / U05 pilot author (agent), by direct inspection of the actual native 640x360 PNGs listed below

separationFromAutomatedTests.statement: This file is a SEPARATE human-style visual evaluation. It is NOT produced by tests/qa-nature02.mjs, NOT a gate, and NOT a pass/fail automated result. Automated QA proves pixel identity, determinism, geometry custody and real keyboard input only. Browser evidence is not Creator visual acceptance.
separationFromAutomatedTests.qaGates: 15/15 PASS (F-G0 … F-G13, F-G2b) — see qa file; these gates do NOT judge beauty, canopy realism or semantic approval.

reviewMaterials.walkingSequences: dense_interior_walk_1..4.png, clearing_walk_1..4.png, road_forest_edge_walk_1..4.png (real WASD, 4 native shots per composition)

observations: NATURE-01 at the same tile shows isolated, evenly spaced 24x32 crowns and tiny 16x16 ground sprites — the reported 'uniform tree scattering' defect is visibly confirmed (compare_dense_interior_nature01.png).

NATURE-02 shows overlapping crowns on 16px tiles forming contiguous forest masses with irregular edges; the largest 8-connected tree cluster is 178 tiles vs 3 tiles in NATURE-01 (objective measurement in nature02-qa.json F-G7).
Pine cones, willow droops and dead snags break the outline; y-sorted drawing puts crowns in front of and behind the hero, giving a shallow sense of depth.
Dense interior, clearing rim and road-side stands read as three different silhouettes at native 1x.
objectiveFailures: Only ONE crown tier exists. Every tree form is a 24x32 canvas with a single blob crown and a thin trunk; there is no overhead canopy, no mid-storey, no sapling and no branching silhouette.

The crown never arches over the hero: the tree is only 32px tall vs the hero's 24px (ratio 1.333), and the crown starts at the very top of its canvas. At 1x the forest reads as a wall of green lollipops seen obliquely, not as a canopy one walks under.
Oak has only 3 variants, pine/willow/dead 2 each; repeated identical crowns are visibly noticeable inside a dense stand.
A soft 0.22-alpha ground shadow ellipse is drawn under tall sprites. It is a render effect, not a SOH asset, and would need art review if this ever became production.

observations: 13 explicitly authored stands each decide their own species mix (oak, oak_pine, pine_oak, willow_oak, ancient_oak), so a stand reads as one ecological unit instead of per-tile random picks.
Willow admixture appears near the lake edge; dead snags appear at stand mantles; elliptical clearings are carved out of stands with a dense low rim.
Natural empty space is preserved: open-ground share 0.6137 dense interior / 0.7035 clearing / 0.6846 road edge (objective audit), no whole-scene fill.
Zero objects on road, bridge, water, river, lake, coast or GOLD sourceTile; zero objects outside the single 96x64 forest window.
objectiveFailures: All trees are the same pixel size and apparent age; there is no size/age variation, no fallen log, no leaf litter and no canopy-dependent ground shading (the verbatim terrain painter is intentionally untouched).
'Ancient' stands use the identical oak/willow sprites as young stands — the label is an authored design intent, not a visible ecological distinction.
The undergrowth is grass/rock/dead-snag sprites only; there is no fern, shrub layer or mid-storey. The forest floor stays the same uniform green noise as the terrain baseline.
Shore transition is limited to a willow weight change; there is no reeds/riparian band because those sprites are harvestable SOURCES and were deliberately excluded.

observations: Three independently reviewable compositions are visibly different at 640x360: dense interior, a legible elliptical clearing with a denser rim, and a forest wall that stops before a clean open strip next to the authored GOLD road.
The authored road corridor is completely unobstructed: 51,424 road/bridge pixels are byte-identical with forest OFF and ON (objective measurement, F-G3).

Real WASD sequences (4 native shots per composition, 1212/1188/1248 px moved, 4 real keydowns + 4 keyups each) show the hero walking through the compositions with camera follow at native 1x; no teleport and no camera trick.
Forest objects never obstruct movement in either collision mode (F-G10, blockedSubsteps equal, movedPx identical with collision ON).
objectiveFailures: Deliberate routes are OBJECT-FREE CORRIDORS ONLY — no path, road, footprint or ground pixel is painted (a hard scope constraint). Consequently the trail is invisible negative space and can be confused with an ordinary natural gap at 1x.
No minimap, trail marker, lighting cue or gameplay navigation permission exists; this is a visual reading test, not a traversal contract.
Walking sequences prove keyboard movement and camera follow, NOT survival traversal, tree collision, harvesting, stamina or route completion.
The authored GOLD road itself renders as a wide brown polygon with a hard stair-step edge. Map may not alter it; a reviewer could misread it as a dirt cliff rather than a road.

observations: Measured from live offscreen canvases: hero canvas 16x24 with alpha bbox 12x23; oak/pine/willow/dead canvas 24x32 (oak alpha bbox 24x32); rock/bush/grass canvas 16x16 (grass visible bbox only 9x9).
Canvas proportions vs hero: tree height 32/24 = 1.333x, tree width 24/16 = 1.500x. Ground sprites are 1.000x hero width and 0.667x hero height.
No sprite was scaled, stretched, enlarged or redrawn; only native 1x drawImage() calls are used. Audit sheet (M key) shows 1x natives plus a clearly-labelled 2x INSPECTION panel that is not in game.
Canopy mass is produced by overlapping 24px crowns on 16px tiles plus y-sorting — a composition technique, not an asset change.
objectiveFailures: At 1.333x hero height the tallest tree rises only 8px above the hero; an overhead canopy is geometrically impossible with the existing art at native scale.

The constraint 'do not enlarge sprites arbitrarily' therefore means the pilot CANNOT honestly claim a convincing survival-forest canopy. Any taller canopy needs a NEW approved asset, not a scale factor.
No DPR other than 1, no zoom other than the existing whole-map overview, and no resolution other than 640x360 was visually reviewed.

observations: INSIDE this pilot every object is decorativeOnly=true, gameplayOwned=false, with no interaction, collision, reward, stock, depletion or owner, and no object occupies a GOLD sourceTile. No contradictory interaction exists within the pilot.
The exact owner dependency is recorded with 8 file/line references in src/nature02/forest-sites.ts OWNER_DEPENDENCY and in evidence/nature02-assets.json.
Palette was reduced to 6 sprites; stocked/depleted Berry Bush (bush/bush_empty), plant SOURCES (herb/mush/reed), depletion states and ore/artificial props are explicitly excluded.
objectiveFailures: In live Gameplay, a visually IDENTICAL oak/rock/grass is a SOURCES entity with stock, yields and block:true (web/src/game/catalog.ts:143,149,156), drawn by the Gameplay source renderer (render.ts:212).

r.natureTrees draws the SAME A.src.oak at x-4,y-16,y+14 (render.ts:215), spawns wood drops/receipts when mature (sim.ts:199) and is SOLID collision class 2 (engine.ts:189); sourceAt() owns stock/hp/regrow/burnt (engine.ts:156).

Therefore two visually identical trees would have contradictory interactions if this pilot were merged. Per the task constraint, NO visually identical trees with contradictory interactions may be approved for production → pilotStatus = NOT_APPROVED_FOR_PRODUCTION.

Map must not invent Gameplay rewards, collision or source ownership; the decision belongs to the Gameplay owner (branch arena/d4bfcfff-soul-of-hero, verified head 5b3e683402bbc8540dea9404576164097e753f97, later observed head 2f0836587b76a4a98fffedf8c202fb37cbb2a67c).
The small asset specification N02-ASSET-GAP-01 is PROPOSED__NOT_CREATED__NOT_APPROVED; no substitute asset was manufactured.

objectiveFailureRegister.failure: No overhead canopy possible with 24x32 trees vs 16x24 hero at native 1x.
Identical sprites are harvestable/solid in live Gameplay; decorative-only pilot objects cannot be approved for production.
Single silhouette tier, only 2-3 variants per species; visible repetition inside stands.
No dedicated non-harvestable undergrowth; grass/rock read as harvestable SOURCES.
Deliberate routes are invisible negative space; no path pixels permitted by scope.
Ground shading, age variation, leaf litter and canopy-dependent floor are absent (verbatim painter untouched).
Authored GOLD road renders as a wide brown polygon with a hard stair-step edge; unchanged by Map.
